column1: # EXCLUDED.jvm.tsv -- jvm: the programs that leave snobol4jvm's denominator ALONE, read by lib_excluded.sh and util_score_row.py only while S4E_ENGINE is jvm
# (R-1864 (4)); SCRIP's rows and the dotnet engine's never read it. Class SNOBOL4PP_EXTENSION_KEPT_BY_LON (Lon 2026-11-17 18:1x CST, in the JVM window,
# verbatim: "let's do more of a SNOBOL4++ where it has all extensions and keeps the dynamic power of SNOBOL4. Have the INPUT and HOST be just like SPITBOL."):
# an entry whose sbl -bf answer turns on a SPITBOL restriction snobol4jvm lifts; its SPITBOL ref stands, its evidence the oracle's answer and the port's.

column3: sbl -bf ends line 2, OPSYN('+','SADD',2), with ERROR 156 (opsyn first arg is not correct operator name); CSNOBOL4 -b lets OPSYN redefine binary plus and prints hello world, and snobol4jvm 4bf04d0 answers as CSNOBOL4 byte for byte, rc 0 (measured 2026-11-21)

sbl -bf ends line 2, OPSYN('*','MYMUL',2), with ERROR 156 (opsyn first arg is not correct operator name); CSNOBOL4 -b lets OPSYN redefine binary star and prints 7, and snobol4jvm 4bf04d0 answers as CSNOBOL4 byte for byte, rc 0 (measured 2026-11-21)

sbl -bf ends line 5, OPSYN('+','ADD',2), with ERROR 156 (opsyn first arg is not correct operator name); CSNOBOL4 -b redefines + ^ - * ?, and snobol4jvm 4bf04d0 answers as CSNOBOL4 byte for byte, rc 0 (measured 2026-11-21)

sbl -bf prints 156, the error OPSYN('STRLEN','SIZE',1) raises under &ERRLIMIT 1, a name that is no unary operator; CSNOBOL4 -b defines it and prints ok, and snobol4jvm 4bf04d0 prints ok, rc 0 (measured 2026-11-21)

sbl -bf prints 156, the error OPSYN('+','SIZE',2) raises under &ERRLIMIT 1, binary plus being no undefined operator; CSNOBOL4 -b redefines it and prints ok, and snobol4jvm 4bf04d0 prints ok, rc 0 (measured 2026-11-21)

sbl -bf prints 156, the error OPSYN('&','SIZE',1) raises under &ERRLIMIT 1, ampersand being no unary operator of SPITBOL's; CSNOBOL4 -b defines it and prints ok, and snobol4jvm 4bf04d0 prints ok, rc 0 (measured 2026-11-21)

sbl -bf ends line 3, OPSYN('^','BR',1), with ERROR 156 (opsyn first arg is not correct operator name); CSNOBOL4 -b defines unary caret, and snobol4jvm 4bf04d0 answers as CSNOBOL4 byte for byte, rc 0 (measured 2026-11-21)

sbl -bf ends line 1, OUTPUT = &DIGITS, with ERROR 251 (keyword operand is not name of defined keyword); snobol4jvm keeps CSNOBOL4's &DIGITS and prints 0123456789, rc 0, byte for byte as CSNOBOL4 -b (measured 2026-11-21 on 4bf04d0)

sbl -bf under &CASE = 1 folds SETEXIT('lab1') to LAB1, no label, and prints 4 F 187 and 5 [], where snobol4jvm never folds case (Lon 2026-11-17 18:2x CST) and prints 4 S and 5 [lab1]; every other line the same (measured 2026-11-21 on 4bf04d0)

sbl -bf under &CASE = 1 folds the names EVAL and CODE read and prints 1 UPPER UPPER and ABC, where snobol4jvm never folds case (Lon 2026-11-17 18:2x CST) and prints 1 lower UPPER and abc; every other line the same (measured 2026-11-21 on 4bf04d0)

sbl -bf after -CASE 1 folds .a2 .a3 .a9 to A2 A3 A9 and reads a lower-case output as OUTPUT, so prints A2 A3 and A9, where snobol4jvm never folds case (Lon 2026-11-17 18:2x CST) and prints a2 and neither of the other two (measured 2026-11-21 on 4bf04d0)
